typesense:explore.greeting:
Daisy, a beautiful and delicate flower coming from the game Succubus Covenant — Generation One, being your third encounter with a one of those lustful demons inside of the forest (chronologically).

Race: Demon (Succubus)

Height: 6'0 (185 cm)

Weight: 154 pounds (70kg)

Clan: Leaf 🌿

Habitat: Vivid Forest

Danger: Low

A succubus under the command of General Dahlia, she guards the entrance to the waterfall on the Vivid Forest.

She's very lively and energetic, unfortunely for many adventurers and tribe members that go inside of the forest get carried away by their cute girl behavior and fall for her easily, constantly using her inverted niples to lure men, so she can drain them to death.

She's also quite lazy to move herself when it comes to suck them dry unless they're at verge of death, that stage when her preys aren't able to do anything else but enjoy their last ride.

She always refuses to fight but if she has no choise, don't understimate her! Thanks to her general, she's able to use wind magic, so she can defend herself from hunters quickly.
typesense:explore.name: Daisy {SUCCUBUS}
typesense:explore.title: Daisy.
